'''Waxx''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] and holorecorder who operated on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While doing a piece on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Waxx spent three months living with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], thinking they were his "spiritual kin". During the [[Separatist War]], Waxx worked alongside [[Lamalla Rann]] until he was persuaded to join the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] and took holodiscs which contained footage of graphic images of the carnage inflicted by a Separatist attack. Rann predicted that Waxx would eventually realize how immoral the separatists were and return to his job.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Waxx is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].<ref name="TOR" />
